description: List the values of one open-vocabulary `search_jobs` filter, optionally narrowed by `q`. Facets: occupations (a role name such as 'registered nurse' → its occupation id, category and subcategory, for occupation_ids), job_categories, job_subcategories (with their category), skills, industries, company_categories, sources (ATS ids). Without `q` it lists the values with the most live jobs, with counts. Use it to turn a role, field or skill the user names into the exact value a filter takes. Free.

q.description: What to look for. For occupations, any part of the role, subcategory or category name ('nurse'); for the other facets, the start of a value ('nurs', 'pyth'). Omit for the most common values.

name: find_filter_values
title: Find filter values
